notes: Replication values are supplied/derived by primary project authors, extracted without conversion. Table character encoding is cp1252; effect metric glyphs preserved as supplied. N (R) is not assumed to be analytic n.  The supplied description specifically names Lag 3; table values concern the omnibus group-by-lag interaction rather than the Lag-3-only comparison. The final report separately prints t(30) = .34, p = .74 for Lag 3; table test preserved and mismatch flagged.
